verdict.rationale: Source availability is a fair question for a government web service, since agencies can and do publish portal code under open licenses, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows the Comptroller publishing Webfile, eSystems or site source code under any license. The open-data portal and the keyless Socrata dataset are open data, not open-source code, and are an adjacent capability that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
